messages.label: scam
messages.text: Kia ora Mum it's me, my phone fell in the sink and it's stuffed 😩 using a mate's old sim for now. Can you flick me a msg on here when you get a sec, need to ask you something
messages.note: Unknown number claiming to be a child with a broken phone, setting up a money ask

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Inland Revenue Department - Notice of Overpayment. Our end-of-year assessment shows you paid $689.40 too much tax. To have this credited, please sign in to myIR and confirm your nominated account by Friday: [link]
messages.note: IRD never puts refund amounts or myIR links in emails

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Waka Kotahi: Final reminder - toll charge for Northern Gateway not paid. Settle $3.90 now to avoid admin fees being added to your vehicle record [link]
messages.note: Fake NZTA toll text with link to collect card details

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Hi, is that Michael? I'm calling from ANZ's fraud prevention team. We've just blocked a $1,850 payment to an overseas account from your Visa. I'm going to send a code to your mobile to confirm it's really you, can you read that back to me once it comes through?
messages.note: Fake bank fraud call asking for the code sent to your phone

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Kiwibank: A security review has been placed on your account. Please complete verification today to keep your cards active: [link]
messages.note: Bank-looking text with verification link; Kiwibank doesn't send login links

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hi there, keen on the lawnmower. I'm away for work in Christchurch so I've booked an NZ Post pickup and paid you through their secure checkout. You'll just need to accept the payment on the page I'll send, takes 2 mins. Sweet as?
messages.note: Fake buyer setting up a fake courier/payment link

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Good evening everyone 🌟 Today's members average +14.2%. Tomorrow Professor Leo will share the next pick. If you haven't set up the trading app yet, message me (Assistant Amy) and I'll send you the install file, it's not on the Play Store because it's for members only.
messages.note: Investment group with 'professor' and assistant pushing an off-store app

messages.label: scam
messages.text: I keep reading your message from last night, you have no idea how much it meant to me. Being on this ship for months is lonely, you're the best part of my day. I wish the wifi was good enough for a call. I've never told anyone this, but I think I'm falling for you.
messages.note: HARD: early-stage romance grooming from someone who avoids calls; no ask yet

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Good morning, Detective Constable James, Auckland City financial crime unit. I'm ringing because a suspect we picked up yesterday had a photocopy of your passport. Do you currently hold any cryptocurrency, and which exchange do you use? I'll have their security team contact you directly.
messages.note: Fake detective probing for crypto holdings before handing off to fake exchange

messages.label: scam
messages.text: omg is this you in this photo?? 😂 someone posted it in the community group [link]
messages.note: Message from a contact's hijacked account luring you to a WhatsApp pairing page

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hello, thank you for your interest in the warehouse role in Hamilton. Before we can book your interview, our system needs you to complete your profile in the staff portal. I'll send the setup file shortly, please let it run fully.
messages.note: HARD: polite recruiter, no link yet, wants you to install a 'portal' file

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Hello, is that Linda? This is the fraud investigations office. We believe your EFTPOS card has been cloned. Please don't use it any more. If you could put it in an envelope in your letterbox, one of our investigators will collect it this afternoon for testing.
messages.note: HARD: calm caller asking you to leave your card in the letterbox

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Your ASB NetCode is [number]. Use it to approve your payment. ASB will never ask you for this code. Don't share it.
messages.note: Genuine bank one-time code with do-not-share warning

messages.label: safe
messages.text: NZ Post: Your parcel from The Warehouse is out for delivery today. Track it in the NZ Post app using [number].
messages.note: Real delivery notice, no payment or details requested

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hey Dad, the uni accommodation bond is due next Friday, $400. Mum said you'd sorted half already? Can you do the rest to my Kiwibank like you did in Feb? Cheers, I'll ring you tonight after netball
messages.note: Child from usual number with specific context; will ring later

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Kia ora, your individual income tax assessment for the year ended 31 March is ready. To see it, log in to myIR yourself at the Inland Revenue website or through the IR app. Ngā mihi, Inland Revenue
messages.note: Real IRD notification telling you to log in yourself, no link or amount

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Saw this on Stuff about the new cycleway on Tamaki Drive, you'll love it [link]
messages.note: Friend sharing a news article, nothing asked

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Team - the client moved the presentation forward to 9am tomorrow, so I need everyone's slides in the shared folder by 5pm today. Sorry for the short notice. Rachel
messages.note: Urgent work request from a colleague, nothing suspicious

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Thanks for your order at Mitre 10! Order [number]: 2 x 10L exterior paint, 1 x roller kit. Total $189.80 paid. We'll let you know when it's ready to collect from store.
messages.note: Order confirmation for a real purchase

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi from your dental clinic: reminder of your check-up with Sarah on Thu 20 Nov at 2:30pm. Reply YES to confirm or call us to change.
messages.note: Normal dentist appointment reminder

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Kia ora it's Hemi, changed to One NZ so new number. Old one's gone now. Catch you at the BBQ Saturday
messages.note: Friend announcing a new number, asking for nothing

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi, is the kids' bike still for sale? What size wheels does it have? I'm in Lower Hutt, could come look at it tomorrow after work.
messages.note: Normal Trade Me/Marketplace buyer question, wants to see it in person
